summary: Clean. Frontend Vue/TS step-form for SET_KEYBOARD/CLEAR_KEYBOARD + i18n. No XSS: all author-entered button text, keyboard text, parse mode, and the keyword hint render via {{ }} interpolation (auto-escaped) or v-model on native inputs — zero v-html / innerHTML / dynamic-attribute sinks introduced (the only v-html occurrences are explanatory comments reinforcing the convention; source guard passes). The amber keyword hint emits a static i18n string, never the raw button text. Client-side validation (4096 hard cap, 1..10 rows, 1..4 buttons, 64-char button text, no duplicates) is an intentional UX mirror of backend Decision 6 — backend 422 funnel_step_invalid remains the authoritative gate, and CLEAR_KEYBOARD correctly omits the SET-only fields to avoid backend symmetric rejection. No hardcoded secrets, no PII leakage, no injection, no SSRF/auth surface in this client component. OWASP Top 10 surface relevant to this code (A03 Injection/XSS) is covered with no issues.
